mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DISPLAY_ORDER, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION WHERE EVENT_PARTICIPATION.EVENT_ID = EVENT.EVENT_ID ) AS PARTICIPATION_COUNT FROM EVENT ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENT ( TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, CREATED_BY, DISPLAY_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{image_url}, NVL(#{is_visible}, 'Y'), NVL(#{is_ended}, 'N'), #{created_by}, #{display_order} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE EVENT
TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_DATE = #{start_date}, END_DATE = #{end_date}, IS_VISIBLE = #{is_visible}, DISPLAY_ORDER = #{display_order},
IMAGE_URL = #{image_url},
WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id}
UPDATE EVENT SET IS_VISIBLE = 'N', IS_ENDED = 'Y' WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id}
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM EVENT WHERE IS_VISIBLE = 'Y' AND IS_ENDED = 'N' AND SYSDATE >= START_DATE AND SYSDATE < END_DATE + 1 ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT EP.PARTICIPATION_ID, EP.EVENT_ID, EP.MEMBER_ID, EP.PARTICIPATED_AT, E.TITLE, M.NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.EMAIL FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION EP JOIN EVENT E ON EP.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID JOIN MEMBER M ON EP.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE EP.EVENT_ID = #{event_id} ORDER BY EP.PARTICIPATED_AT DESC

SELECT EP.PARTICIPATION_ID, EP.EVENT_ID, EP.MEMBER_ID, EP.PARTICIPATED_AT, E.TITLE, E.IMAGE_URL, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION EP JOIN EVENT E ON EP.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID WHERE EP.MEMBER_ID = #{member_id} ORDER BY EP.PARTICIPATED_AT DESC

SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id} AND IS_VISIBLE = 'Y' AND IS_ENDED = 'N' AND SYSDATE >= START_DATE AND SYSDATE < END_DATE + 1
